title: OL-20261126-2: READ-BUDGET-10 follow-ups: remaining D1 readers and the Actions executor's model rungs
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** next hourly cost sample over the cap, or executor run failing on every rung
**Done check:** grep:foundation/agents.py::MODELS-ORG-1
**Status:** open

Evidence: after the 0034 indexes and the ROI and criticality caches the org D1 rolling-hour reading fell from 187k to about 139-158k rows against the 120k cap (cost_samples, 2026-11-26 14:33 UTC), so the lean mode may persist for another sample or two. Remaining readers by rows an hour: the originated-item count in the criticality window (about 25k; its count must stay live, because a stale value would make the tick originate duplicates), verified_outcomes_7d in tick.js (about 11k), live_changes (about 17k). Separately, the Actions executor's code-agent rungs all fail: GitHub Models answers HTTP 200 with the text OK on both endpoints and the Workers AI route through the site Worker returns 502; the tick Worker's own executor does not use them.
